title: Unrefusable Offer
text:
Attach to a non-leader unit.
Attached unit gains: “Bounty — Play this unit for free (under your control). It enters play ready. At the start of the regroup phase, defeat it.”
rules:
“Play for free” ignores all resource costs, including the aspect penalty, but not other additional costs.
(ERRATA) Attach to a non-leader unit. Attached unit gains: “Bounty — Play this unit from its owner's discard pile or from capture for free (under your control). It enters play ready. At the start of the regroup phase, defeat it.”
